name: Zola Ndlovu
bio:
Zola Ndlovu's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a metalworker specializing in precision engineering for the mining industry, Zola's exceptional skills soon caught the eye of a local racing team struggling with chassis fabrication. Her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication to quality quickly transformed their fortunes, leading to numerous podium finishes.

Driven by an insatiable desire to push boundaries, Zola joined Brasil Racing fifteen years ago, where she has become known for her innovative solutions and uncompromising standards. While her demanding nature can sometimes ruffle feathers, it's undeniable that her pursuit of perfection has elevated the team's performance. Zola is particularly adept at identifying stress points in vehicle designs and implementing reinforcing modifications to enhance durability, a skill that has earned her the respect of drivers and engineers alike.

physical.hairStyle: short, tightly coiled afro, streaked with grey at the temples
physical.description: Zola is a powerfully built woman with a focused gaze and hands calloused from years of crafting metal.

quirks: Always wears her lucky welding helmet, even when not actively welding.
Insists on listening to mbaqanga music while working, regardless of others' preferences.
Has a habit of sharpening her tools obsessively, even when they're already razor-sharp.
